title: What happens to a photo you upload
subtitle: From the browser to a thumbnail on the page

scenes.title: One photo, step by step
scenes.narration: Here is what happens to one photo, from the moment you pick it to the moment its thumbnail shows up.

steps.say: Your browser tells the server it has a photo, and how big it is.
The server answers with a link that lets the browser upload straight to storage, for the next five minutes.
The browser sends the photo straight to storage, so the server never carries the big file.
Storage keeps the photo and announces that a new file arrived.
A small worker hears that, and makes a thumbnail a hundred times smaller.

scenes.title: One upload on a home connection
scenes.narration: On a typical home connection the whole trip takes about four seconds, and most of it is the upload itself.

steps.say: Getting the link takes a tenth of a second.
Sending the photo takes over three seconds.
The thumbnail is ready less than a second after that.
